svg.title: June 1967: six days, four territories
svg.desc: Situation map covering 31.9°E to 37.0°E, 27.6°N to 33.5°N. The West Bank with East Jerusalem, the Gaza Strip, the Golan and Sinai, occupied by Israel. Change in ground held by Israel, May 1967 to July 1967: held throughout 24%, taken 76%. Both extents are OpenHistoricalMap relations, whose 'Israel' after June 1967 is the ground Israel controlled, not territory the UN recognises as Israel's. Names follow UN usage: the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and the occupied Syrian Golan; the 1980 and 1981 annexations are not recognised (UN Security Council resolutions 478 and 497). OpenHistoricalMap's relations for this region carry 'needs source' on their boundary lines, so the lines are as precise as a crowd-sourced record of them, no more. The UN General Assembly partition plan of November 1947 (resolution 181) is not drawn: no open vector of it exists, only the UN's scanned map 103.1(b). OpenHistoricalMap relations 2864015 and 2742218 (CC0); Natural Earth basemap. Before 5 June and after 10 June 1967. 2 mapped features can be reached with the Tab key, each one naming what it is.
